verdict.rationale: Rive documents an in-editor AI agent, an MCP connection, RML, and an agent-facing CLI. These are on-demand, user-initiated generation workflows. Nothing shows automations that can be configured to run autonomously in the background, such as recurring schedules, triggers, or unattended jobs, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
